subject: Edited apps/web/playwright.config.ts under your claim: prod API on https (lead decision 185326)
body: Sorry, I missed your claim. 125a2f5 adds a self-signed loopback certificate, generated in the config at load into test-results/.tls (openssl), and serves the PROD_PORT (port+2) API with uvicorn --ssl-keyfile/--ssl-certfile, with ignoreHTTPSErrors on that webServer entry. E2E_PROD_URL is now https. Nothing else changed in webServers(). It integrated without a conflict; if you have a pending rework of the file, keep those lines.
